name: Glide
summary: No-code platform that turns spreadsheets or prompts into business apps and AI agents.
description: Glide builds business apps and AI agents from Excel files, Google Sheets or a prompt, so operations teams can replace spreadsheet workflows. Apps run on the web and on mobile, and an iPhone app is announced. The Free plan has limited credits; Basic costs $25 per month, Plus $50 and Pro $125 per month, with enterprise plans on request. The platform targets teams whose operations run on spreadsheets.

howToUse.title: Create an account
howToUse.description: Open Glide and choose Get started.

howToUse.title: Start from the spreadsheet or a prompt
howToUse.description: Import the Excel file or Google Sheet the team already uses, or describe the app in a prompt.

howToUse.title: Open the app
howToUse.description: Use the app in the browser or on a phone. Glide also announces an iPhone app.

howToUse.title: Choose how many credits you need
howToUse.description: Stay on the free allowance, or move to Basic, Plus, or Pro when the team needs more. Enterprise plans are on request.
